## Results Preview

We examined the training dynamics for the $d=256$ bottleneck configuration.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-training-loss
#| fig-cap: "Training and Validation Loss for BERT Adapter (d=256)"
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

p = "../results/nlp_baseline/adapter_dim~256/learning_rate~0.0001/training_stats.parquet"
df = pd.read_parquet(p)

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
sns.lineplot(data=df, x='epoch', y='train_loss', label='Train')
sns.lineplot(data=df, x='epoch', y='val_loss', label='Val')
plt.title("Adapter Training (d=256, lr=1e-4)")
plt.ylabel("Loss")
plt.xlabel("Epoch")
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.show()
```
